findings.finding: Share-count scope: the point-in-time count 3,952,757,946 (2026-10-15) includes 423,743,904 unearned 2025 CEO Performance Award restricted shares (milestones mostly 'not probable'; 105.82B-120.37B of their SBC unrecognized) and about 286.5M restricted shares from the 2018 award exercise vesting 2028-01-19. These shares are excluded from the 3,541M diluted weighted count. Valuing per share on 3,953M while also forecasting the award's SBC (9.74B probable plus the not-probable tranches) counts the same dilution twice; on 3,541M it is missed.
